question: Can PEE reconstruct, from the original page context and general scientific knowledge, the observation-contract slots that the stored tables leave unknown, without adding category-specific rules and without introducing errors, on publishers not used to develop the method?
owner: owner review of S87d (verbatim, owner-review-s87d-2026-10-19.md): experimental, reversible, no migration; measure declarations, quantitative tests, qualitative judgements and comparisons separately; keep explicit, inferred and undetermined apart; technique chosen by Claude among those studied in S87c

declarations.context: page bytes retained locally for all rows; context recovered by locator245 (label, value, section, table header or caption, nearest headings, surrounding text)
declarations.reference: blind annotation by a separate Claude agent of a host-stratified sample (up to 4 quantity + 2 categorical per host), sealed by hash before any reconstruction is run on it
declarations.split: hosts ordered by sha256(host); development = the first hosts covering at least 20% of the sample; check = all other hosts

quantitativeTests.context: S80 raw pages; block by block_sha256/block_index
slots: role (measured result vs declared spec vs test condition)
quantitativeTests.reference: S86b blind page annotations (sealed in evaluation/s86b/page-reference-freeze.json), matched by page, value and unit
quantitativeTests.split: development = trustedreviews.com; check = housefresh.com and expertreviews.co.uk
quantitativeTests.caveat: S80 pages were spent by S86c development of the reader; the reconstruction method is new

qualitativeJudgements.note: small; descriptive only, against Phase269/272 gold where pages match

comparisons.note: no page bytes retained: reconstruction from documents not testable offline; structural only (S87e step 1 comparison sets)

techniques.A: knowledge typing of the value and its own label (QK typing; S87b structural classifier)
techniques.B: A + document role filling by evidence rules (same element, table header/caption, section heading, method section, page product)
techniques.C: B + combination of the available signals as abstaining labelling functions (majority vote with abstention on conflict; WRENCH/Snorkel baseline)

selection: the technique is chosen on development groups only; then frozen (hash) and run once on check groups; first check run committed unchanged
metrics: per type and slot: explicit recovered, inferred (with rule), undetermined; precision of produced values against the reference; coverage; errors introduced (a previously unknown slot made wrong); per host or publisher; worst group
constraints: no category-specific rules: any vocabulary used must be general (metrology, document structure) or come from knowledge data
stopRule: at most three reformulations on development data

declarationSplit.rule: hosts in sha256(host) order until >=20% of the sample
